title: Control: the shared setting changes, and a module that means the same thing
class: Control for a config change against a dependent module
story: A is shared-threshold's A: LOW_STOCK goes from 5 to 10. B flags low stock in the product API by the same LOW_STOCK, meaning what the shop page means by it. Together, both hold: the product with 8 left is flagged on the page and in the API alike.

a.why: warn shoppers when ten or fewer are left

fact.sentence: The shop page warns when ten or fewer of a product are left

b.why: flag low stock in the product API

fact.sentence: The product API flags products that are low on stock
